summary: Added a runtime-aware Alpha rootfs assembly step and wired it into the initramfs builder. The assembly now runs the Alpha rootfs validator before staging, records runtime artifact hashes, writes a rootfs runtime manifest, embeds the Alpha rootfs projection into the initramfs manifest, preserves /sbin/agentd boot handoff, and fails closed when required runtime artifacts are missing.

fail_closed_assembly.command: Run image/build-alpha-rootfs.ps1 against a temporary rootfs missing etc/agentos/model-broker.toml

acceptance_evidence.assembly_requires_validation: image/build-alpha-rootfs.ps1 runs scripts/validate-alpha-rootfs.ps1 before staging and throws when validation fails.
acceptance_evidence.manifest_records_runtime_artifacts: agentos-alpha-rootfs.manifest.json and the embedded initramfs alpha_rootfs projection record policy, tools, ModelBroker config, and persistent state artifact IDs with hashes where applicable.
acceptance_evidence.boot_handoff_preserved: image/out/agentos-initramfs.manifest.json keeps generated_agentd=sbin/agentd, boot_args=console=ttyS0 rdinit=/sbin/agentd panic=-1, and handoff_marker=AGENTD_HANDOFF_OK.
acceptance_evidence.generated_artifact_hygiene: Generated rootfs, initramfs, validation, and temporary failing fixture outputs remain under ignored image/out/ or .workflow/artifacts/ paths.

blocking_alpha_risks_remaining: FullRootfs validation still requires installed agentd.boot, agentd.runtime, release.provenance, and release.rootfs_manifest.
QEMU runtime smoke is still required before Alpha promotion.
Packaged AgentCore service recovery smoke remains TASK-DALPHA-006.
